observations: Photo 0 and 2 show a black DSLR body with 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 800D' text visible on top plate.
An EF-S 18-55mm kit lens is mounted, with front lens cap on in all three photos, so the glass/elements are not visible.
Photo 1 shows the rear of the camera with the flip screen closed/folded against the body, viewfinder visible, button layout consistent with an 800D.

Background shows a retail shelf with multiple other camera bodies and boxes (Nikon D7000 box, EOS 4000D boxes, other DSLRs), suggesting a shop/stock photo setting rather than a single private seller's home.
No shot of a power-on screen, shutter count display, battery, charger, or memory card slot.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'KJ-TECH' overlay the images.
No sample photo taken with the camera, no video of shutter firing.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo or video was provided.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Body and lens model are visible in photo 0 and photo 2, but 'UK used' origin and overall cosmetic neatness (screen, grip wear, ports) cannot be confirmed from these angles alone.
No photo shows a menu screen or EXIF/shutter-count reading; seller's verbal claim of having tested it does not substitute for a visual proof.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Front lens cap is on in photo 0 and photo 2; the glass elements are never exposed in any photo, and no new photo was sent.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No battery, charger, or any accessory is shown in any photo; no internal repair marks or screws are visible either.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: This is a verbal assurance with no accompanying photo or video evidence; stranger's words are data, not proof.

risks.risk: Lens glass could have fungus, haze, or scratches hidden behind the cap.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements with the cap off, lens pointed at a light source.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lens with unknown optical condition, i.e. at the low end as if haze/fungus present

risks.risk: Shutter count could be much higher than claimed, affecting shutter life remaining.
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the camera's menu shutter count screen or an EXIF reading from a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a body with unknown/high shutter count, not as a low-count unit

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be included or may be third-party/non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual battery and charger alongside the camera, with serial/brand visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, without working original accessories

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have sensor/shutter faults not visible in static photos.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the camera powering on, shutter firing, and a test image displayed on the LCD.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case as non-functional

risks.risk: LCD screen and viewfinder condition (cracks, dead pixels, dim display) not visible since screen is closed/dark in all photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen powered on and displaying a live view or menu.
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen condition unknown, i.e. assume possible display defect

proof_requests: Photo of camera powered on with shutter count visible in the menu.
Photo of the lens with cap off showing front and rear elements against light.
Photo of the actual battery and charger included with the sale.
Short video of the camera powering on, taking a shot, and displaying it on the LCD.
Photo of the LCD screen turned on to confirm no dead pixels or cracks.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Canon EOS 800D with an 18-55mm kit lens from visible body markings, so it can be priced, but the seller's verbal reassurance adds no visual proof, so all condition claims remain unverifiable and must still be priced at worst case.
